name: sidekick
description: A bar above the prompt (TL;DR briefs from a session record, heads-up, rules, replay), a multi-repo scope guard, long-lived rules, a resume warning, trimming instead of summary compaction, and tools to ask the Codex and Antigravity CLIs with your approval on every call.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for TL;DR briefs, heads-up notes and the policy judge.

replayEnabled.title: Edit replay
replayEnabled.description: Record each turn's file edits and offer /replay to step through them.

summaryEnabled.title: TL;DR briefs
summaryEnabled.description: Keep a record of each session (in ~/.claude/sidekick/ledgers, secrets redacted, 14 days) and show the TL;DR button, which briefs it only when clicked.

headsUpEnabled.title: Heads-up notes
headsUpEnabled.description: Show the Heads up button on the bar (it reviews the last answer only when clicked).

noteLength.title: Explanation length
noteLength.description: How long the explanation behind a note is.

focusTopics.title: Watch especially for
focusTopics.description: Topics heads-up notes should weigh first, e.g. "security, data loss".

ignoreTopics.title: Never raise
ignoreTopics.description: Topics heads-up notes should never raise, e.g. "formatting".

scopeGuardEnabled.title: Scope guard
scopeGuardEnabled.description: Block changes outside this session's target folders, once set with /scope set or add.

inlineCodeBanEnabled.title: Inline-code ban
inlineCodeBanEnabled.description: Refuse Bash and PowerShell commands that run interpreter code written into the command line (node -e, python -c, a heredoc piped to node, Invoke-Expression…). A council order's agent is refused; in your own session you are asked.

policyJudge.title: Policy judge
policyJudge.description: Which Bash and PowerShell commands the model judges against the policy when code can't clear them: every session's (all), subagents' only (agents), or none (off). One call per command, on this session's sign-in; an agent is refused what it blocks, you are asked.

judgeBudgetAgent.title: Judge calls per agent
judgeBudgetAgent.description: The most policy-judge calls one subagent may use; past it, its uncleared commands are refused until the session restarts.

judgeBudgetSession.title: Judge calls for your session
judgeBudgetSession.description: The most policy-judge calls your own session may use; past it, you are asked about each uncleared command instead.

judgeMaxSegments.title: Uncleared parts per command
judgeMaxSegments.description: A command with more parts than this that code can't clear is refused without a model call, with a request to split it.

classifierUsageCap.title: Judge usage cap (%)
classifierUsageCap.description: Pause the policy judge once your 5-hour usage passes this percentage; paused, the commands it would judge are refused for agents and asked about for you.

ruleSuggestionsEnabled.title: Rule suggestions
ruleSuggestionsEnabled.description: Show Rule? on the bar after the scope guard blocks something; a click asks for a rule suggestion, which you approve.

resumeWarningEnabled.title: Resume warning
resumeWarningEnabled.description: Hold the first prompt of a resumed session whose prompt cache has likely expired.

trimEnabled.title: Trim instead of summarizing
trimEnabled.description: When Claude Code compacts automatically, replace old tool output with stubs instead of a summary (keeping your answers, subagent reports and errors), if that frees enough.

trimAtPercent.title: Trim threshold (%)
trimAtPercent.description: How full the context must be when the automatic compaction fires for a trim to be considered.

trimTargetPercent.title: Trim only if it gets to (%)
trimTargetPercent.description: Trim only when it would bring the context down to this percent or less; otherwise leave it to normal compaction.

trimKeepTurns.title: Turns kept whole
trimKeepTurns.description: The newest turns whose tool output a trim leaves alone. At least 1, so a trim during a turn never touches that turn's own tool calls.

contextReadoutEnabled.title: Context readout
contextReadoutEnabled.description: Show how full the context is and what the last turn added on the bar; its panel breaks it down.

councilButtonEnabled.title: Council button
councilButtonEnabled.description: When the council mod is installed, show a ⚜ Council button on the bar.

askToolsEnabled.title: Ask Codex and Antigravity
askToolsEnabled.description: Offer Claude the ask_codex and ask_agy tools when the codex or agy CLI is on PATH at session start. Every call asks for your approval and bills that CLI's plan.
